name: edit_file
description: Replace one occurrence of old_string with new_string in the file at file_path (every occurrence with replace_all). The match is exact and runs against the file as open in the IDE, unsaved changes included. The user reviews the change in a diff and may alter it before it lands; the result tells you what was applied.

file_path.description: Absolute path, inside the project or an added folder

name: write_file
description: Create the file at file_path with content, or replace an existing file's content. The user reviews it in a diff and may alter it before it lands; the result tells you what was applied.
